title: Regional hospital with clinical devices and vendor access

organisation.name: Calderbrook Regional Hospital
organisation.size: 3,800 staff; an IT team of 30 with two security analysts
organisation.summary: Calderbrook Regional Hospital runs its electronic health record (EHR) system and Active Directory in its own data centre. Clinicians use shared workstations on the wards, and remote staff reach the EHR through a remote access gateway that offers both per-application access and a legacy full-tunnel VPN. Infusion pumps report to a clinical device gateway that writes into the EHR, and the imaging (PACS) server is supported by its vendor through an always-on remote support tool. EHR backups go to a cloud backup service, and a SIEM collects domain controller logs and EDR alerts.

network_security.summary: The clinical segment routes into the data centre, so a compromised PACS server reaches AD
The legacy full-tunnel VPN profile puts vendors and IT on the internal network

endpoint_security.summary: A ward workstation runs a dropper from a file-sharing link
The PACS server has no EDR, so tools staged there go unseen

identity_access.summary: The PACS service account is local admin on every workstation with a 2016 password
Break-glass access lets any clinician open any record

incident_response.summary: Ransomware spreads across ward workstations toward the EHR
Unexplained vendor sessions on the PACS server at night

security_operations.summary: PACS service account sign-ins are filtered as noise in the SIEM
A phishing alert on one workstation followed by unusual record browsing

threat_intelligence.summary: An advisory on a ransomware group entering hospitals through vendor remote access
Intelligence on scanning for exposed medical device gateways

zero_trust.summary: Any signed-in user reaches the EHR through the remote gateway, whatever their device
The EHR trusts whatever the device gateway writes

data_security.summary: EHR backups sit with a cloud provider behind one admin account
Medical images with patient identifiers are on a share every workstation can read

grc_risk.summary: The PACS vendor's always-on access is not in the risk register
Unpatched infusion pumps share a network with the device gateway

reviewNotes: Intermediate: a domain-joined, vendor-managed PACS server is the bridge between the clinical segment and AD; the remote gateway has a legacy full-tunnel profile; the SIEM filters the one account that matters.
